test_only_keys: Every key in this file is derived from a trivial TEST-ONLY seed. Never use these keys outside tests.

verification_context.description: Shared context for all 'verify' vectors: the root keys built into the client, the certificates offered in web.keys (all 'certificate' vectors in file order), the revocation list named by each vector, and the time at which certificate expiry is checked.

vectors.name: key/root-01
vectors.description: TEST-ONLY root key (seed 32 x 0x01). key_id = first 16 bytes of SHA-256 of the raw 32-byte public key.

vectors.name: key/publisher-02
vectors.description: TEST-ONLY publisher key 'acme' (seed 32 x 0x02). key_id = first 16 bytes of SHA-256 of the raw 32-byte public key.

vectors.name: key/publisher-03
vectors.description: TEST-ONLY publisher key 'beta', revoked (seed 32 x 0x03). key_id = first 16 bytes of SHA-256 of the raw 32-byte public key.

vectors.name: key/uncertified-04
vectors.description: TEST-ONLY uncertified key (seed 32 x 0x04). key_id = first 16 bytes of SHA-256 of the raw 32-byte public key.

vectors.name: key/publisher-05
vectors.description: TEST-ONLY publisher key 'gamma', certificate expired (seed 32 x 0x05). key_id = first 16 bytes of SHA-256 of the raw 32-byte public key.

vectors.name: key/publisher-06
vectors.description: TEST-ONLY publisher key 'delta', namespace without trailing dot (seed 32 x 0x06). key_id = first 16 bytes of SHA-256 of the raw 32-byte public key.

vectors.name: key/publisher-07
vectors.description: TEST-ONLY publisher key 'omega', certificate signed with the wrong domain (seed 32 x 0x07). key_id = first 16 bytes of SHA-256 of the raw 32-byte public key.

vectors.name: key/publisher-08
vectors.description: TEST-ONLY publisher key 'epsilon', certificate expires exactly at the verification time (seed 32 x 0x08). key_id = first 16 bytes of SHA-256 of the raw 32-byte public key.

vectors.name: cert/acme
vectors.description: Publisher certificate: key 'acme' may sign modules whose id starts with 'acme.' until 2027-01-01.

vectors.name: cert/beta
vectors.description: Publisher certificate for key 'beta' (namespace 'beta.'). The key is revoked by revocation/list-3.

vectors.name: cert/gamma-expired
vectors.description: Publisher certificate for key 'gamma' that expired on 2026-11-01.

vectors.name: cert/delta-no-dot
vectors.description: INVALID: namespace 'delta' does not end with a dot. Correctly signed, but must be rejected.

vectors.name: cert/omega-wrong-domain
vectors.description: INVALID: signed over ['sparrow-module-v1', ...] instead of ['sparrow-cert-v1', ...].

vectors.name: cert/epsilon-boundary
vectors.description: Certificate whose expires equals the verification time: not valid (valid only strictly before expires).

vectors.name: revocation/list-3
vectors.description: Revocation list seq 3 revoking key 'beta', signed by the root key. Used by the default verification context.

vectors.name: revocation/lists-root
vectors.description: Root-signed list (seq 4) naming the root key's own key_id and publisher key 'beta'. The entry naming a root key is ignored and the rest of the list applies (9.5): the root stays trusted, 'beta' is revoked.

vectors.name: revocation/forged
vectors.description: List claiming root_key_id of the root key but signed by publisher key 'acme', revoking 'acme'. Only a list signed by a root key counts, so it is ignored.

vectors.name: module/acme-charts
vectors.description: Module 'acme.charts.ui' of facet acme.charts, signed by the certified publisher key 'acme'; has assets and load.

vectors.name: module/acme-core
vectors.description: Module signed directly by the root key.

vectors.name: module/wrong-domain
vectors.description: Signed by 'acme' over ['sparrow-cert-v1', entry] instead of ['sparrow-module-v1', entry].

vectors.name: module/namespace-not-covered
vectors.description: Signed by 'acme', whose namespace 'acme.' does not cover 'acmecorp.widgets'.

vectors.name: module/namespace-no-dot
vectors.description: Signed by 'delta', whose certificate namespace 'delta' lacks the trailing dot. 'delta.maps' starts with 'delta', but the certificate is invalid.

vectors.name: module/revoked-key
vectors.description: Signed by 'beta', which revocation/list-3 revokes.

vectors.name: module/expired-cert
vectors.description: Signed by 'gamma', whose certificate expired before the verification time.

vectors.name: module/expiry-boundary
vectors.description: Signed by 'epsilon', whose certificate expires exactly at the verification time (strictly-before rule).

vectors.name: module/cert-wrong-domain
vectors.description: Signed by 'omega', whose certificate signature used the wrong domain string.

vectors.name: module/uncertified-key
vectors.description: Signed by a key that is neither a root key nor certified.

vectors.name: module/tampered
vectors.description: Signed for version 1.4.2, then 'version' changed to 1.4.3 after signing.

vectors.name: file-hash/charts-css
vectors.description: Asset file hash in schema-hash format: 0x01 || SHA-256(file bytes).

vectors.name: verify/acme-charts
vectors.description: Accept or reject module/acme-charts. Module 'acme.charts.ui' of facet acme.charts, signed by the certified publisher key 'acme'; has assets and load.

vectors.name: verify/acme-core
vectors.description: Accept or reject module/acme-core. Module signed directly by the root key.

vectors.name: verify/wrong-domain
vectors.description: Accept or reject module/wrong-domain. Signed by 'acme' over ['sparrow-cert-v1', entry] instead of ['sparrow-module-v1', entry].

vectors.name: verify/namespace-not-covered
vectors.description: Accept or reject module/namespace-not-covered. Signed by 'acme', whose namespace 'acme.' does not cover 'acmecorp.widgets'.

vectors.name: verify/namespace-no-dot
vectors.description: Accept or reject module/namespace-no-dot. Signed by 'delta', whose certificate namespace 'delta' lacks the trailing dot. 'delta.maps' starts with 'delta', but the certificate is invalid.

vectors.name: verify/revoked-key
vectors.description: Accept or reject module/revoked-key. Signed by 'beta', which revocation/list-3 revokes.

vectors.name: verify/expired-cert
vectors.description: Accept or reject module/expired-cert. Signed by 'gamma', whose certificate expired before the verification time.

vectors.name: verify/expiry-boundary
vectors.description: Accept or reject module/expiry-boundary. Signed by 'epsilon', whose certificate expires exactly at the verification time (strictly-before rule).

vectors.name: verify/cert-wrong-domain
vectors.description: Accept or reject module/cert-wrong-domain. Signed by 'omega', whose certificate signature used the wrong domain string.

vectors.name: verify/uncertified-key
vectors.description: Accept or reject module/uncertified-key. Signed by a key that is neither a root key nor certified.

vectors.name: verify/tampered
vectors.description: Accept or reject module/tampered. Signed for version 1.4.2, then 'version' changed to 1.4.3 after signing.

vectors.name: verify/root-not-revocable
vectors.description: module/acme-core (root-signed) with revocation/lists-root in effect: root keys cannot be revoked, so the module is accepted.

vectors.name: verify/publisher-revoked-by-list-naming-root
vectors.description: module/revoked-key (signed by 'beta') with revocation/lists-root in effect: the list also names the root key, whose entry is ignored, but the rest applies, so 'beta' is revoked.

vectors.name: verify/forged-revocation-ignored
vectors.description: module/acme-charts with revocation/forged in effect: that list is not signed by a root key, so it does not count and 'acme' is not revoked.

vectors.name: module-scope/acme.charts/acme.charts.ui
vectors.description: Starts with the facet name and a dot.

vectors.name: module-scope/acme.charts/acme.charts.ui.extra
vectors.description: Deeper ids are fine.

vectors.name: module-scope/acme.charts/acme.charts
vectors.description: Equal to the facet name: allowed (9.4).

vectors.name: module-scope/acme.charts/acme.chartsx.ui
vectors.description: Shares a string prefix but not the facet name followed by a dot.

vectors.name: module-scope/acme.charts/acme.notes.ui
vectors.description: Another facet's name: a facet cannot ship modules under another facet's name.

vectors.name: module-scope/acme.charts/acme.charts.Ui
vectors.description: Upper case: module ids follow the ASCII facet-name grammar.

vectors.name: module-scope/acme.charts/acme.charts.café
vectors.description: Non-ASCII: module ids follow the ASCII facet-name grammar.

vectors.name: module-scope/hub-b_acme.charts/acme.charts.ui
vectors.description: Imported facet: the '<peer-id>/' prefix a hub added is ignored.

vectors.name: module-scope/hub-b_acme.charts/acme.charts
vectors.description: Imported facet, id equal to the unprefixed name.

vectors.name: module-scope/hub-b_acme.charts/hub-b/acme.charts.ui
vectors.description: Module ids never carry the prefix ('/' is outside the grammar).

vectors.name: module-scope/sparrow.web/sparrow.web.core
vectors.description: Facet 1 may ship modules named after it.

vectors.name: module-scope/facet-web-keys
vectors.description: A facet's own annotations may carry only web.modules; a client ignores any other web.* key in a facet, and reads web.keys, web.revoked and client configuration from top-level schema annotations only (section 9.4). Non-web keys are untouched.
